title: 第十七章 神秘宝盒第十八章 精明的商人与挟持事件
content_zh:
“鸪图这个姓氏还真是少见啊！”颜铁龙听到鸪图莉雪的的姓氏有点意外嘀咕道。
“大哥哥，我，咳！我的名字很奇怪吗？”鸪图莉雪听到颜铁龙的嘀咕，她疲惫的问道。
“没有啊，我觉得小雪的名字很好听啊，对了小雪，你能告诉哥哥你难受这种情况，是什么时候开始的呢？”颜铁龙带着微笑对眼前小萝莉称赞道同时也询问她病情是什么时候开始的。
“咳！二天前晚上，我头就昏昏沉沉，当时我只是以为我太累了。”鸪图莉雪一边咳嗽一边回忆道。
颜铁龙听到鸪图莉雪二天前就昏昏沉沉内心担忧的想道：“二天了，希望只是发烧感冒，千万不要引发其病症状才好！不然那就麻烦了。”。
颜铁龙他急忙从怀里拿出一个小瓶子，看到小玻璃瓶子里们，只有一片咖啡色的药片嘀咕道：“我擦！治疗发烧感冒的特效药这么只剩下一片了，看来等有时间要采集一些药材，炼制一批才行。
恩~，一片对小雪来说量太大了，那试一试四分之一吧，希望不要出现其它反应。”。
颜铁龙把出小玻璃瓶软木塞，从小玻璃瓶子倒出最后一片药，并从腰间把出一把精致匕首，对药片划了二下，将要片一分为四，颜铁龙将四分之三的药碎片放回小玻璃，盖好软木塞，拿起四分之一药碎片递到鸪图莉雪前面，提醒道：“小雪这药很苦，你要记住千万不要吐出来。”。
“哥哥，咳！我吃了这药就能马上好吗？咳！”鸪图莉雪看了看眼前药询问道。
颜铁龙直接点头，鸪图莉雪看到颜铁龙点头样子就拿起四分之一的药片，闭上眼睛直接吞了下去，当她吞下药片就邹起眉头不由自主地说道：“好苦！！”。
“鸪图莉雪好勇敢！”颜铁龙对鸪图莉雪竖起大拇指称赞道，而鸪图莉雪听到颜铁龙称赞微笑道：“哥哥，谢谢。”。
“咔擦！”“什么声音？”颜铁龙突然听到什么断裂的声音，皱起眉头认真竖起耳朵来。
“哥哥，这么了？”鸪图莉雪看到颜铁龙神情变的认真就问道。
颜铁龙右手食指放到嘴巴边虚的一声，让鸪图莉雪不要出声，鸪图莉雪看到颜铁龙动作就双手捂住自己的小嘴巴。
“咔擦！”“咔擦！”颜铁龙又听到一连串什么东西断裂声，同时颜铁龙开始感觉房子向前倾斜就眼睛睁大说道：“我擦，我的运气这么倒霉，这房子这么要塌了！”。
颜铁龙快速抱起鸪图莉雪要冲出去，可是当颜铁龙抱起鸪图莉雪之时，鸪图莉雪手里有小熊布偶，她一边挣扎一边大声喊道：“哥哥，妈妈东西！”。
颜铁龙感觉房子越来越不稳定就急忙对怀里的鸪图莉雪问道：“你妈妈东西在哪里？”。
鸪图莉雪也知道时间紧急就直接喊道：“床下，有绳子地下！”。
颜铁龙听到怀里鸪图莉雪的话直接一脚将床踢飞撞到墙壁变成碎片，而颜铁龙看向地板上有绳子直接将鸪图莉雪左手抱住，右手拉起绳子。
当颜铁龙看到机关打开，地板里面一个盒子，他并没有看清盒子什么样子，直接抓起盒子抱好鸪图莉雪直接冲向离自己最近的窗户。

颜铁龙以自己加速撞向木窗，从二楼窗户冲出外面，在期间颜铁龙用自己的身体保护好鸪图莉雪直接从要倒塌二楼房子窗户冲掉落到街道，并先前的加速力直接以滚的过街道，最后以后背撞到街道另一边的民房墙壁上而结束。
同时颜铁龙他们刚冲出之时，鸪图莉雪家轰隆隆的倒塌。
“疼～疼～！老子运气真好，差一点活埋啊！”颜铁龙后背以及一些擦伤疼的脸直抽搐，看着眼前倒塌的房子庆幸道。
“小雪，你有没有受伤？”颜铁龙对自己怀里极力保护的鸪图莉雪抱着补丁的小熊布偶就关心问道。
颜铁龙并没有听到鸪图莉雪回应就急忙查看她的情况，最后发现她只是疲劳以及刚刚的刺激晕了过去，庆幸道：“没事就好。”。
“这东西这么看，都不是像小雪她们应该拥有的东西！”颜铁龙拿出先前拼命拿出来的鸪图莉雪母亲的盒子，当他看清盒子精美图像就自言自语嘀咕道。
颜铁龙看着精美的盒子越看越喜欢，而他脑袋总觉得这盒子在哪里见过，而且脑袋还提供了一个信息，那就是拥有这个盒子就用能拥有大量的财富，颜铁龙因为这个信息脑袋上空突然上出现黑色羽的恶魔形态小型颜铁龙和洁白无瑕翅膀的天使形态小型颜铁龙。
“颜铁龙这盒子这么珍贵，这两个小丫头片子根本就无法保护它，你收下，是你应得的。”小恶魔颜铁龙提议收下宝盒
“你这个可恶的家伙，什么应得的，颜铁龙你怎么能抢小孩子的东西！而且，这宝盒可能是她们母亲的遗物”小天使颜铁龙说出不能收下宝盒的理由。
“你怎么说了这么难听，我们可没有抢小孩子东西，这是那些小丫头片子给我们的医药费！”。小恶魔颜铁龙辩解道。
“你们没有经过主人的同意就擅自拿走它，那就是偷和抢！你们这种行为是不对的。”小天使颜铁龙斥责道。
content_en:
"The surname Zitu is really rare!" Yan Tielong muttered in surprise when he heard the last name of Zitu Lixue.
"Brother, I, cough! Is my name weird?" Lutulixue asked tiredly when she heard Yan Tielong's muttering.
"No, I think Xiaoxue's name is very nice. By the way, Xiaoxue, can you tell your brother when did you start feeling this bad?" Yan Tielong praised the little loli in front of him with a smile and asked her when the condition started.
"Ahem! Two nights ago, I felt dizzy. At that time, I just thought I was too tired." Qitu Lixue recalled while coughing.
Yan Tielong heard that Qitu Lixue had become groggy two days ago and thought worriedly: "It's been two days. I hope it's just a fever and a cold. Don't cause any symptoms! Otherwise, it will be troublesome."
Yan Tielong hurriedly took out a small bottle from his arms. When he saw that there was only one brown pill in the small glass bottle, he muttered: "I'll take it! There is only one piece left of the special medicine for treating fever and cold. It seems that when I have time, I need to collect some medicinal materials and refine a batch."
Well~, one slice is too much for Xiaoxue, so try a quarter, and hope there won’t be any other reactions. ".
Yan Tielong took out the cork from the small glass bottle, poured out the last piece of medicine from the small glass bottle, took out a delicate dagger from his waist, scored the tablet twice, and divided the tablet into four. Yan Tielong put three-quarters of the medicine fragments back into the small glass, covered the cork, picked up a quarter of the medicine fragments and handed it to Qitu Lixue, reminding: "Xiaoxue, this medicine is very bitter, you must remember not to spit it out."
"Brother, cough! Can I feel better immediately after taking this medicine? Cough!" Qitu Lixue looked at the medicine in front of her eyes and asked.
Yan Tielong nodded directly. Seeing Yan Tielong's nodding, Qitu Lixue picked up a quarter of the pills, closed her eyes and swallowed them directly. When she swallowed the pills, she frowned and said involuntarily: "It's so painful!!".
"Zutulixue is so brave!" Yan Tielong gave a thumbs up to Zhetulixue and praised him, and Zhetulixue heard Yan Tielong's praise and smiled and said: "Brother, thank you.".
"Crack!" "What sound?" Yan Tielong suddenly heard a breaking sound, frowned and pricked up his ears carefully.
"Brother, is this all?" Qitu Lixue asked when she saw Yan Tielong's expression becoming serious.
Yan Tielong put his right index finger to his mouth and made a weak sound, telling Qi Tuli Xue to be silent. Qi Tu Lixue saw Yan Tielong's movements and covered her small mouth with both hands.
"Crack!" "Crack!" Yan Tielong heard a series of breaking sounds. At the same time, Yan Tielong began to feel the house tilt forward and his eyes widened and he said, "Oh my god, my luck is so unlucky, this house is going to collapse!".
Yan Tielong quickly picked up Lutulixue and wanted to rush out, but when Yan Tielong picked up Lutulixue, Lutulixue had a stuffed bear in her hand. She struggled and shouted loudly: "Brother, mommy!".
Yan Tielong felt that the house was getting more and more unstable, so he hurriedly asked Qitu Lixue in his arms: "Where are your mother's things?".
Qitu Lixue also knew that time was urgent and shouted directly: "Under the bed, there is a rope underground!".
Yan Tielong heard the words of Qitu Lixue in his arms and kicked the bed away, hitting the wall and turning it into pieces. Yan Tielong saw a rope on the floor and hugged Qitu Lixue with his left hand, and pulled up the rope with his right hand.
When Yan Tielong saw the mechanism open and a box on the floor, he didn't see clearly what the box looked like. He grabbed the box, hugged Tu Lixue and rushed towards the window closest to him.
Yan Tielong accelerated himself into the wooden window and rushed out from the second-floor window. During this period, Yan Tielong used his body to protect Qitu Lixue and rushed directly from the window of the second-floor house that was about to collapse to the street. The previous acceleration force directly hit him with his body.He rolled across the street and finally hit his back against the wall of a house on the other side of the street.
At the same time, just when Yan Tielong and the others rushed out, the Yutuli Xue house collapsed with a rumble.
"It hurts! It hurts! I'm so lucky, I was almost buried alive!" Yan Tielong's back and some bruised and painful face twitched, looking at the collapsed house in front of him and said happily.
"Xiaoxue, are you injured?" Yan Tielong asked with concern for the patched bear puppet that Qitu Lixue was trying to protect in his arms.
Yan Tielong didn't hear Qitu Lixue's response and hurriedly checked her condition. In the end, he found that she just fainted from fatigue and the stimulation just now, and said happily: "It's okay."
"Looking at it this way, it's not something Xiaoxue and the others should have!" Yan Tielong took out the box belonging to Lixue's mother that he had desperately taken out earlier. When he saw the beautiful image on the box, he muttered to himself.
The more Yan Tielong looked at the exquisite box, the more he liked it, and his head always felt that he had seen this box somewhere before, and his head also provided a message, that is, owning this box would lead to a lot of wealth. Because of this information, Yan Tielong suddenly appeared in the sky above his head, a small Yan Tielong with black feathers in the form of a devil and a small Yan Tielong with pure white wings in the form of an angel.
"Yan Tielong, this box is so precious. These two little girls can't protect it at all. You deserve it." The little devil Yan Tielong suggested accepting the box.
"You hateful guy, you don't deserve anything. Yan Tielong, how can you snatch things from children! Moreover, this treasure box may be their mother's relic." The little angel Yan Tielong said the reason why he could not accept the treasure box.
"Why did you say it so harshly? We didn't rob the children. This is the medical expenses those little girls gave us!" The little devil Yan Tielong argued.
"If you take it without the owner's consent, that is stealing and robbing! This behavior of yours is wrong." Little Angel Yan Tielong scolded.
